To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
interprofessional education can improve collaborative working and that this can improve patient care.
Interprofessional education is a promising strategy for developing collaborative working, but we do not yet know what the most effective strategies are.
interprofessional education is an important strategy to prepare students and trainees to work together effectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how we might best educate the work force to ensure that they are able to work together effectively.
the question of how we educate healthcare professionals in order to prepare them to work together in a collaborative way.
the development of a work force that is prepared for the realities of collaborative practice and that can work together to deliver quality healthcare.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the best way to achieve interprofessional education is to do it in a way which allows students to recognise, and value, the difference arising from a range of professions and their practice, and which fosters attitudes that enhance collaboration and engender interprofessional learning.
IPE is a necessary component of the education of all healthcare professionals.
the evidence base is not sufficient at this time to support the claim of the effectiveness of IPE in achieving the goals of collaborative working in healthcare.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

interprofessional education is an effective strategy to prepare health professionals to work together effectively, and that we need to work together as educators to ensure that our education programmes achieve their aims.
we must ensure our students learn the skills and values of collaboration, and are able to work effectively with colleagues from other disciplines to provide the best patient care.
we need to educate health professionals to collaborate and work in teams, and that interprofessional education is a key strategy in this process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IPE is not just about teaching students to work together, but also requires us to think differently about how we educate and how we work together.
IPE can and must be a key part of health care education.
we need to work together, and we need to learn together.
